newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds feel the heat from high dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds feel the heat from high dollar.

text.p: European meals continued to feel the pressure from a combination of high seller prices and dollar level on Friday, which is keeping consumers sidelined.
Traders said the combination of the recent rise in Chicago futures, aided by fund buying, and the increased U.S. currency has pushed prices in Europe to their highest for years.

The market in Europe once again only witnessed scattered trades in nearby material with consumers only willing to buy products on a hand-to-mouth basis. There were no trades in Argentine or Brazilian soybeanmeal.
